title: B2EMO
subtitle: Independent
description: Known as Bee-two -or even Bee- B2EMO was a groundmech salvage assist Droid. Bee-two spent many years serving the Andor family and was with Maarva and Clem Andor when they landed on Kenari and found Cassian and rescued him from the disaster there. On Ferrix, still serving Maarva and Cassian, B2EMO was an old and weary Droid, skittish and emotional.
